The Dotdigital region id your account belongs to (This can only be one of r1,r2,r3)

Manage automation programs and enrolments. Use this API to list all programs,
retrieve a specific program by ID, create enrolments for contacts or address
books into a program, check enrolment status, retrieve enrolments filtered by
status, and download a fault report listing contacts that failed to enrol.
